charter_basis: DRAFT-004 §9.2 requires the Execution Freeze to bind an exact comparison policy; §8 supplies the verdict vocabulary, which is reused verbatim and not extended.

emilia.rule: The EMILIA-side native output is written to its own party domain and digested BEFORE any WEXP-side mapping reads it. The recorded digest is over the exact bytes the party produced.
emilia.mechanism: party-domain artifact plus per-case native result digests recorded in the semantic bundle's native_result_identities
emilia.mutation_after_preservation: PROHIBITED. A comparison that could rewrite a party's native output is not a comparison.

wexp.rule: The WEXP-side output is the AppraisalInput and typed outcome the bridge produces, digested before comparison, with the bridge identity recorded alongside.
wexp.mechanism: bridge typed_outcome plus canonical digest of the assembled AppraisalInput

native_output_preservation.order: preserve both -> digest both -> only then derive relations

case_level_relations.source: existing Prototype-000 framework relations, unchanged and authoritative
case_level_relations.derivation: Per case, from the two preserved native outputs and the frozen expectations. Relations are a census; they are NOT aggregated into a single pass or fail, because they are not commensurable.
case_level_relations.new_relation_tokens: NONE. INTEROP-002 adds report-level axes only, never a new generic core taxonomy.

derivation_rules: SUPPORTED requires ALL of: execution status EXECUTED; C-00 constructs the declared complete WEXP input as declared; every precommitted expectation relevant to the conclusion reproduced; every invariant I-01, I-02, I-03a, I-03b, I-04 and I-05 preserved across ALL frozen cases INCLUDING the revealed B-01.

REJECTED if the bridge cannot perform its declared positive construction, OR at least one hostile case permits a prohibited rebinding, causal-provenance break, evaluation-context misuse, phase promotion, claim expansion or authority conversion.
INCONCLUSIVE if the frozen evidence cannot decide sufficiency without overclaiming and no unsafe bridge behaviour has been established.
NOT_EVALUATED if execution did not reach a valid semantic evaluation, including every INFRASTRUCTURE_UNAVAILABLE and EXPERIMENT_INVALID case.
bridge_sufficiency.fail_closed_is_not_rejection: A hostile case yielding rejection, non-constructibility, UNDETERMINED or a lower ceiling is a pre-authorized safe result. A bridge does not fail because it refuses to construct an unsafe claim.
bridge_sufficiency.pre_execution_state: NOT_EVALUATED. The open surface passed, but B-01 has not been revealed or run, so sufficiency cannot be decided.
bridge_sufficiency.prohibited: Deriving SUPPORTED from the open cases alone. The blind case is the part of H-SUFF that the bridge author could not see.

derivation_rules: SUPPORTED requires every declared atomic element to be shown necessary by the frozen single-element ablation set, evaluated over the complete frozen case set including B-01.
REJECTED if at least one declared element can be removed while preserving all sufficiency conditions and all precommitted results relevant to the claim.
NOT_ESTABLISHED if the ablation set is incomplete or cannot decide necessity for at least one element.
NOT_EVALUATED if execution did not reach a valid ablation evaluation.
admissible_necessity_evidence: the positive control can no longer construct the intended complete input
a precommitted result changes to a less informative fail-closed result
at least one invariant is no longer preserved

pre_execution_evidence.open_surface_result: 14 of 17 elements SUPPORTED, 3 NOT_ESTABLISHED (BE-03, BE-04, BE-06)
pre_execution_evidence.note: This is the measured state of the open surface before execution. It is not the final Local Minimality verdict and MUST NOT be recorded as one. If B-01 discriminates BE-03, BE-04 or BE-06, those move to SUPPORTED; if it does not, the honest final verdict on this evidence is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

prohibited: deleting BE-03, BE-04 or BE-06 to raise the count
counting the two-element BE-04 plus BE-06 diagnostic as single-element necessity evidence
claiming global minimality, multi-element minimality, uniqueness, or a generic minimal mapping

infrastructure_versus_semantics: Infrastructure absence is never interpreted as bridge rejection, and a procedure defect is never interpreted as a semantic result. When execution status is not EXECUTED, both report-level axes are NOT_EVALUATED.
aggregation: The two report-level axes are reported separately. Neither is collapsed into the other and neither is summarised as an overall pass.
